book.name: Jon
book.title: Jon Jisas Krais Manö Aij u Jon kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka

content: Jisas waiö lö bɨ nɨpe unbö mudun jɨŋ u nɨp nɨŋla
Pen hainö hon Jisas bɨ nɨpe gau Ñɨg Waŋö Daibirias au mɨdaino nɨŋöm Jisas nɨpe waiö lö nɨŋno. Nɨhön ga u hagnɨg gabin.

Saimon Pida u, Domas u (hib ap Ñɨ Ramö a gal u), Nadanyel Kena daun, ram mɨnöŋ Galili au nɨbö u, Sebedi ñɨ Jems hol mamil mɨhau, Jisas bɨ nɨpe mɨhöp halö aip, jɨm ñöl am Ñɨg Waŋö Daibirias au mɨdaino.
Saimon Pida hanɨp haga, “Yad kabsaƚ nan arabin,” a ga. Hageia, “Hon aip arnabun,” a gun, am nɨp aip ñɨg magɨb udun, gɨ ajno ajno ram rua pen kabsaƚ rɨmnap udagno.
Pen sɨdö lɨm gö nɨŋöl gɨ, Jisas ap ñɨg waŋö goƚ au mɨdeia. Nɨp nɨŋno pen u Jisas nöp a gun nɨŋagno.
Nɨpe hanɨp haga, “Ñɨ game. Kale kabsaƚ nan gɨ aj wasö nɨŋbim ar?” a ga. Hageia, hon yau a gɨno.
Anɨg hagaino, hanɨp haga, “Uben u ud ñɨg magɨb ñɨmagö yɨjɨg kɨd lau adö yumim me, kabsaƚ rɨmnap udnabim!” a ga. Hageia, uben u ud ñɨg aŋ yaŋ yuun, kabsaƚ iru yabɨƚ nöp udun, ɫɨp gɨno aunɨm rö laga.
Anɨg geia, yad Jon, Pida nɨp hagnö, “Bɨ anɨbu Bɨ Kub u nöp,” a gɨnö. Anɨg hagainö, Pida nɨŋöm, waƚɨj nɨpe au la u ud hib nab aŋ au gɨdaŋ pɨralöm, ujaŋɨd ñɨg aŋ yaŋ la.
Hon bɨ rɨmnap ñɨg magɨb adö u mɨdun, uben kabsaƚ halö ap ran jaköm mɨdeia u, ɫɨp gɨ dap, mɨlö gau wasö, mida unbö ñɨnjuöl mamɨd (100) rö nöp, ñɨg goƚ au auno.
Goƚ anɨb au apun nɨŋno, mab in bɨc ara adö u, kabsaƚ rɨmnap in mɨdeia. Bred rɨmnap u rö nöp mɨdeia.
Pen Jisas hanɨp haga, “Kabsaƚ mɨñi udpim gau, rɨmnap dauim,” a ga.
Hageia, Saimon Pida ñɨg magɨb adö u amöm, nɨpe aip uben kabsaƚ iru nöp (153) mɨdeia anɨbu kabö kuƚup adö au ɫɨp gɨ dauno. Uben u marö ga pen pa gɨ dö gaga.
Jisas pen hanɨp haga, “Apim, nan ñɨŋim,” a ga. Hon pen nable gö, ne bɨ an ammön mɨdpan a gun nɨp hag nɨŋagno; u Bɨ Kub u nöp a gun, nɨŋun arö gɨno.
Jisas nɨpe am bred u udöm, hanɨp nɨme löm, kabsaƚ abe ud hanɨp nɨme löm gö, ñɨŋno.
Pen Jisas umöm uraköm, hanɨp bɨ nɨpe gau ij mɨhau nɨgaŋ waiö lö nɨp nɨŋno.
Jisas Pida nɨp manö haga

Pen hon nan ñɨŋ pɨs gun, Jisas Saimon Pida nɨp hag nɨŋa, “Saimon Jon ñɨ nɨpe. Bɨ gai i rö wasö; ne yɨp nɨŋö nöp mɨdmagö lɨban aka?” ga. Hageia, Pida haga, “Bɨ Kub. Yad nöp mɨdmagö lɨbin u, ne nɨŋban me,” a ga. Anɨg hageia, Jisas haga, “Sipsip pi yad gau, abad mɨdaimön,” a ga.

Jisas anɨg hagöm, kauyaŋ hag nɨŋa, “Saimon Jon ñɨ nɨpe. Ne yɨp nɨŋö nöp mɨdmagö lɨban aka?” ga. Hageia, Pida haga, “Bɨ Kub. Yad nöp mɨdmagö lɨbin u, ne nɨŋban me,” a ga. Anɨg hageia, Jisas haga, “Sipsip yad gau abad mɨdaimön,” a ga.

Jisas kauyaŋ pen hag nɨŋa, “Saimon Jon ñɨ nɨpe. Ne yɨp mɨdmagö lɨban aka?” ga. Pen Jisas anɨg göm, manö adö añɨ anɨbu nöp, “Ne yɨp mɨdmagö lɨban aka?” hag nɨŋöm hag nɨŋöm gö me, Pida gasɨ iru nɨŋöl gɨ haga, “Bɨ Kub. Ne nan gau magöŋhalö nɨŋban. Anɨb u, yad nöp mɨdmagö lɨbin u, ne hadö nɨŋban me,” a ga. Hageia, Jisas haga, “Anɨb u, sipsip yad gau abad mɨdaimön.

Yad nöp nɨŋö yabɨƚ hagabin, ne bɨ praj rö mɨdaina ñɨn u, waƚɨj gasɨ ne ke nɨŋna rö ud lɨmön ajmɨdan. Pen ne hainö bɨ mɨƚep lɨnabön ñɨn u, ne ñɨmagö ne gɨlaŋ gɨ mɨdö nɨŋöl gɨ, bɨ ke nɨbö ap nöp nagɨ adɨköm, aragnabön mol u uɫ gɨ ud arnab,” a ga.

Jisas manö haga anɨbu, nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap hainö Pida al pak lɨnaböl u, Jisas nöd nɨŋa me u. Nɨbi bɨ hain nɨbö gau, Pida nɨp nan nɨhön gɨnaböl umnab u nɨŋöm, God nɨpe mailö aij unbö ke halö mɨdöp u nɨŋnaböl. Pen Jisas Pida nɨp haga, “Yɨp hain gɨmön,” a ga.

Jisas manö anɨbu haga nɨŋöm Pida ado göm nɨŋa, yad bɨ Jisas mɨdmagö lɨmɨdöp u mɨdainö. Yad bɨ anɨbu me, nöd Jisas Pasopa nan ñɨŋ mɨdeia iƚ au asɨk mɨdem hag nɨŋnö, “Bɨ Kub. An nöp mumug gɨnab?” ö gɨnö.
Pida yɨp nɨŋöm Jisas nɨp haga, “Bɨ Kub. Bɨ i nɨp nɨhön gɨnab?” ö ga.
Hageia, Jisas haga, “U gasɨ yad. Yad hagnö nɨpe mɨdep nöp mɨdö nɨŋöl gɨ, ado gɨ aunabin u, manö ne wasö. Pen ne yɨp hain gɨmön,” a ga.

Jisas manö haga anɨbu, nɨbi bɨ nɨp nɨŋ udla rɨmnap hagla, “Jisas bɨ nɨpe anɨbu umagnab,” a gɨla. Pen Jisas bɨ nɨpe anɨbu umagnab a göm manö anɨbu hagaga; nɨpe yɨharɨŋ haga, “Yad hagnö, nɨpe mɨdep nöp mɨdö nɨŋöl gɨ, ado gɨ aunabin u, manö ne wasö,” ga.
Jisas bɨ nɨpe anɨbu me, nɨpe ke manö anɨbi kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm, magöŋhalö manö nɨŋö yabɨƚ nöp mɨdöp u nɨŋöm, kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköp me u.

Jisas nan adö ke ke iru nöp ga u pen manö anɨbu yöp rɨmnap nöp aŋ aui kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköp. Yad nɨŋnö, manö anɨb gau magöŋhalö kalɨ kƚiñ rɨk buk iru nöp yaŋ lɨblap, mɨnöŋ naböŋ i pro gö, dam lep ka u mɨdagaiböp.
